answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 7765 Country: India Title: Can property belonging to a masjid be rented to a BANK. Can the rent received from property rented to a bank be used for tne expenses of the masjid? Question: Can property belonging to a masjid be rented to a BANK. Can the rent received from property rented to a bank be used for tne expenses of the masjid? Answer ID: 7765 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1776/1489=B/1429) It is makrooh to give mosque property on rent to a bank. It is better not to use the money for the mosque. A mosque is our sacred place and house of Allah; we should use pure money for the same: ان اللہ طیب، لایقبل الا الطیب Allah is pure and he likes purity. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
